topic: Function Template Specialization and Operator Overloading with Smart Pointers
explanation: This concept demonstrates how C++ allows defining generic functions and operators using templates, enabling code reuse across different types. Specifically, it shows how to overload operators for smart pointers like std::unique_ptr to customize their behavior when used with specific types or conditions. Template specialization and operator overloading enhance type safety and expressiveness in modern C++, allowing developers to define intuitive interfaces for complex types such as smart pointers.
